creator: Luis Candanedo
citation: Candanedo, L. (2017). Appliances Energy Prediction [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5VC8G.
aggregation: Sum six distinct ten-minute Appliances readings per hour, divide by 1000.
timestamp_semantics: Hour start in the source's naive local clock. No UTC conversion or daylight-saving adjustment is inferred. The value is known after that hour.
scope: One low-energy building, about 4.5 months in 2016; not whole-building load.
